**Build from scratch around Haaland's armband — the £15.5m spearhead is the foundation of your GW1 season launch.**

**✅ What's strong**
This 5-3-2 packs serious value at £100.0m, with a projected XI haul of 54.94 pts. Captain Haaland is the obvious call — nailed, on pens, and firing 0.86 xGI/90. The defence is where the DEFCON gold sits: Senesi (4.85 xP, 11.5 tackles+/90) and Tarkowski (4.75) rack up the +2s most weeks, backed by clean-sheet magnets Guéhi and Virgil. In midfield, B.Fernandes (4.66) brings penalties, free-kicks and 0.68 xGI/90. No injury or fitness flags to worry about this week.

**🔄 What I'd change**
Building from scratch, so prioritise the spine: Haaland up top as captain, pair him with Thiago (4.60) for a nailed, penalty-taking foil. Load your back five with high-DEFCON bargains — Senesi, Tarkowski, then dip into differentials like Thiaw (£5.0m, 4.29) and O'Shea (£4.0m, 4.19) to free up cash. Anderson (4.61) rounds out a reliable midfield.

**Bottom line: Haaland captain, a DEFCON-heavy defence, and you're off the line flying.**
